text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaaah----!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What an unexpected—no, what a magnificent 
turn of events! The winner of this year's 
Satsuki Sho is—!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Haa...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Why... am I in a place like this?! Why, 
me...?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Why aren't you in the winner's circle?! In 
the very first leg of the Triple Crown, of 
all races...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Why can't I get any results...ugh!! At 
this rate...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"No, I was truly astonished! To think 
she'd take 1st place!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, this is getting intense! As expected 
of the Golden Generation!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
“Still... ah well. It's a bit of a shame. 
For that young Umamusume lady to lose.”

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
—Even though she's the "daughter" of a 
legendary Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there is no problem. Aside from the 
fact that I lost, that is.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Don't get the wrong idea, though. I'm not 
someone who gives up over something like 
this.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I fell behind this time, but next time, I 
will bathe in the praise I truly deserve.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...That is the moment I will be recognized 
not just as first-rate, but as King Halo 
herself.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. Coming up next is the main event 
of the Classics, the 'Japanese Derby.'"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: We will take it, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And upon returning to the academy with 
King Halo...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer, ...see you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh, King-chan?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Special... Week-san.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it really is you, King-chan. I'm 
glad it wasn't someone else~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but meeting this late... Could it 
be...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Are you heading out for a run too, 
King-chan?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? 'Too'?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're not thinking of running right now, 
are you—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah, 'cause next up is the Nippon Derby!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I made a promise to my mom. That I'd 
become the best horse girl in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's why I thought I really have to do 
my best. Today's race made me feel that so 
strongly.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was truly so strong. That's why 
I'm not giving up the next Derby to 
anyone.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...For the sake of my two mothers, the one 
who gave birth to me, and the one who 
raised me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm heading out first! See you 
tomorrow! At school!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
She has a mother who places high 
expectations on her, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. I'll grant you the privilege 
of joining me for just one lap of distance 
running."
choice_data_list: You must be tired, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: There is no need for such concern.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
There are victories that I refuse to give 
up, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night, King Halo's running didn't 
stop at just one lap.
